exact_missing_items: Governing layer design: deterministic scheduler/state machine (not one long-running super-agent); bounded worker/reviewer/remediation agents with explicit context windows; lightweight planning/replan agent only at graph-construction or graph-patch boundaries
Handoff chain must be: requirements-doc-builder → interview flow → PRD-builder → graph-plan inputs → handoff to Orchestrator; each step has defined output artifacts

In Plans/Contracts_V0.md: add canonical route_target contract section under chapter 7.

The clean contract placement is: keep 7.1 UICommand envelope; add route_target and OpenSubject as new sibling contract sections inside chapter 7; keep WiringEntry after those sections so the wiring layer consumes, rather than owns, route/open semantics.
This is not just a missing paragraph. The owner-doc section order already tells us where the contract belongs.
Interviewer flow: conversational-to-structured pattern that produces documents for the node/contract system
Issue classes requiring corroboration (5): missing wiring, implementation quality concerns, unmet intent despite passing tests, missing spec/hidden dependency, graph structure insufficiency
Keep `active_subview`, filters, compare targets, pinned selections, and similar fields in destination/view-state contracts.
Let routes optionally name a destination-local subview only when that is necessary for the task, but treat it as destination refinement, not base identity.
Reuse persisted project/surface state when the route does not specify a destination-local override.
The route model should be able to land a user in Source Control without becoming a full serialized `source_control.project_state`.
Keep `route_target` intentionally small and force normalization pressure through `subject_id` and `object_kind/object_id`.
Let specialized contracts carry specialized selectors: `OpenFile` owns `path`, `line`, `range`; `OpenSubject` owns `subject_id` and subject realization rules
Avoid adding a generic nested 'extra args' bag to `route_target`; that would recreate the same drift under a different name.
Keep the initial canonical set deliberately small: `doc:<document_id>`, `artifact:<artifact_id>`
Avoid adding `thread:`, `run:`, `wizard:`, `safe_point:`, etc. as `subject_id` families when those are better modeled as `object_kind/object_id`
Declare the initial `subject_id` families narrowly and explicitly.
Declare an early canonical `object_kind` enum family in the contract layer, with room for later controlled extension.
Make storage-plan.md the owner of generic projection freshness/health projection fields
Contracts_V0.md should own cross-cutting persisted-envelope field families and stable event names
Prompt_Pipeline.md should own requested/effective runtime resolution semantics
Multi-Account.md should own policy, selection rules, provider capability posture, and account-routing semantics
UI_Command_Catalog.md should own stable command IDs and command argument families, but not the deeper route ontology by itself
Glossary.md should own canonical terms, not behavior
